entities.name: Skrygix
entities.description: Student mentor at Ravnica High who gives the new student an orientation tour and belongs to no clique.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: Planeswalker, here a lighthearted vice principal of Ravnica High who calls assemblies and hands out detention.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: Dragon, here principal of Ravnica High, rarely around because of a big research project.

entities.name: Isperia
entities.description: Sphinx, here the school secretary who keeps things running and has the vice principal's ear.

entities.name: Lavinia
entities.description: Azorius student watching the narrator and tour group.

entities.name: Ravnica High
entities.description: Lighthearted high-school version of Ravnica where each guild is a clique.

entities.name: Azorius Senate
entities.description: Guild portrayed as smug hall monitors.

entities.name: Gruul Clans
entities.description: Guild portrayed as rowdy roughs in flannel and stompy boots.

entities.name: Orzhov Syndicate
entities.description: Guild portrayed as bullies who take lunch money.

entities.name: Golgari Swarm
entities.description: Guild portrayed as students whose food should not be eaten.

entities.name: Boros Legion
entities.description: Guild portrayed as team-playing jocks and defenders.

entities.name: Cult of Rakdos
entities.description: Guild portrayed as drama-club performance artists.

entities.name: House Dimir
entities.description: Guild portrayed as black-trench-coat live-action roleplayers.

entities.name: Selesnya Conclave
entities.description: Guild portrayed as friendly, guitar-playing kids in the student lounge.

entities.name: Izzet League
entities.description: Guild portrayed as tech, AV club and robot battle enthusiasts.

entities.name: Simic Combine
entities.description: Guild portrayed as lab-coat science geeks who stitch creatures together.

entities.name: Gateless
entities.description: Students who fit into no guild clique.

events.summary: Skrygix leads a new student on an orientation tour of Ravnica High, describing each guild as a student clique.
events.quote: Well, that about finishes up the tour.

relations.note: the vice principal and principal are tight
relations.quote: But he and Beleren are tight, that's for sure.
some of them call themselves the Gateless
